notes.title: Project X 2023 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/634a01facfabe98fc4a1f09082f3a1d810e292e0.jpg[/img]

Hi friends! It's been a while since I lasted posted here. Hope you've all been doing awesome ːflorinehappyː!

Those who are in our discord and newsletter already know this, but we've been doing daily on our new game for the past few years now (we started while working through those Clea 2 post launch updates). Our team just released a vertical slice last week in fact, just in time for Halloween season. Details can be found here: [url=https://twitter.com/InvertMouse/status/1713308548749496390]https://twitter.com/InvertMouse/status/1713308548749496390[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/006a7ee833a51a27231fd153fb5f5dd533d32a30.jpg[/img]

Project X (placeholder name) will be the spiritual conclusion to the Clea series. There's still a multi-year development journey ahead, but I hope you'll support and enjoy what we've put together when that release day comes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/195c6b9134f27fa742e7a44a465bd8c125e52174.jpg[/img]

I also want to thank everyone here for making this possible. From opening day, one of the goals behind developing Clea was to put together a collection of custom scripts/libraries so that, after Clea's release, we can build upon it into something bigger. With Project X, that plan is clicking into place. To achieve this, we also need funding. Project X is our most expensive game to date, and it's thanks to the sales from Clea we're able to support this endeavour. You could say this is sort of our game. It's the community's game ːbibiːːyoyoː.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/3a8286bd91ec472f128c8c2ab939668cb3ebceff.jpg[/img]

Project X's vertical slice dropped last week, and throughout the past 6-7 days, I've been working through everyone's feedback to improve the game. A version 2 of the vertical slice just got published a few hours ago actually. Here are the patch notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/0a16cf1085ceeaa715031ee420fe1ba6f0d91cea.jpg[/img]

To finish up, a reminder if you'd like to join our discord or newsletter communities, the link to both can be found on our website: [url=https://invertmouse.com/]https://invertmouse.com/[/url]

Thank you and Happy Halloween! It's back to work for me, but I'll also make sure to enjoy this October with lots of horror content ːcleachaosː.

notes.title: War Maiden Mode unleashed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/b0bf694610c4609df34aead6c052c654b4fdb65d.jpg[/img]

(Please note the above contains costumes from both Clea 1 and 2.)

Hey buddy! Hope you are doing good ːcleasunniesː.

As promised, the final, ultimate test of skills has arrived. War Maiden Mode is now available in both Clea 1 and 2. Please note I will be testing the console versions after this, so thank you for your patience, and you can expect the same patch to drop on those platforms soon.

In Clea 1, War Maiden Mode can be unlocked by completing the campaign with the best ending. In Clea 2, War Maiden Mode becomes available once you have conquered Clea's Quest with a silver or higher rank. Survive War Maiden Mode, and the War Gear will be yours. Let it be a proof of your dominance and mastery. The dress contain a cute little ability, which I will leave as a surprise ːexceliaː.

Alongside War Maiden Mode, I have applied a series of tweaks/improvements:

- When you are in an area afflicted with the noise curse, the background ambience will be replaced by chants (for clarity).
- The peek blocking corruption no longer denies you from looking through doors. This felt too unfair.
- Chaos Spiders will now flee, or at least fail to kill you, if they attack right as you are entering a door or closet.
- On Chaos+ difficulty, players will be able to sneak closely behind enemies without being unfairly killed.
- Chaos+ exclusive foes now have slightly different sounding footsteps so you can tell when there are multiple hunters in play.
- Revised the spawn times of some Chaos+ exclusive enemies to improve fairness.
- Minor graphical fixes to some costumes (the candle flames were too solid in a few).
- Fixed bug where on rare occasions, the player character flickers for a frame when a chapter is completed.
- Audio balancing for a lot of sound effects, many of which were too loud. There were also sound effects that would play twice in succession when they were not meant to.

Remember, the Gaia dress has also been added to Clea 1. Complete the campaign with one save or less, and the costume shall be yours. With this third update, there is no better time to re-visit both titles ːwhappyː.

What comes after this? There may well be more Clea related news. We always got work going on, and speaking of which, I should get back to it. Thank you and have fun ːbibiː!

P.S. The Clea 1 and 2 artbooks have been updated with the new costumes, along with artworks tied to the One Year Mission. Hope you like them!

notes.title: War Maiden Mode Survival Guide
notes.content:
Hey bud! Hope you are doing good ːyoyoː.

As mentioned last time, War Maiden Mode is about to drop. The new costumes had been ready for a while now, and War Maiden’s curses had also been programmed earlier for Clea’s Quest. This should have been the easiest update, yet it turned out to be a lot of work. Why is that?

You see, I had to test War Maiden Mode on every difficulty to ensure things did not go out of hand. At first? Things went completely off the rails. Dare I say the mode on Chaos+ was nigh unbeatable. I mean, not even chapter one.

A load of balancing took place, and at last, the mode is ready. Please let me be clear, though. This is still the final, ultimate test. It is by far the toughest challenge Clea players will face. I borderline advise against tackling this on Chaos+ difficulty. There will be deaths, and you will feel frustrated. But, if you are one of the rare few who do survive, I acknowledge you as a true Clea master.

To aid you on your journey, I have compiled some tips in this article. Good luck and have fun. While the mode has been balanced to ensure luck is not needed, it certainly would not hurt.

Now, on with the guide (please note all the screenshots are from Clea 1).

[b]Candle usage:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/d39d91327f31f5c35f2f2e66e69a304d76d984a8.jpg[/img]

I have seen many players in streams hoarding candles. The sentiment is understandable. After all, I too can be a hoarder when I game.

Alas, this is not the time to be saving up. When you feel pressured, it may be time to light that candle. You will be hunted endlessly, so get used to it. Originally, some candles were set to be hidden on Chaos+. I have opted to re-enable them in the next patch, because you will need every last one. This is the tier of madness we speak off.

At the highest skill level, candles can be used to manipulate enemy positions. Each time an enemy flees, they will run to a different area. Let’s say you use a candle, and your hunter runs to the left room, but you would rather he headed right. Well, remember how a candle stays on until you leave the area? You can always run around on the spot, lure the enemy back in, then see if they go right this time. Remember to be patient, and also, please note some foes are coded to roam within specific areas. If you cannot seem to persuade an enemy to run into a certain room, that could be why.

As you may know, unless you are on Light difficulty, or you have ticked infinite saves, each save is going to cost you a candle. It is not in my place to tell you how to play, but in War Maiden Mode on Chaos+, let’s just say there is no shame in playing with infinite saves. On the off chance you actually clear the campaign on Chaos+ with limited saves, you are officially more skilled than the game’s creator.

[b]Chaos management:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/eebe2d48c8fbfd859104fb3a68c640ad55b59ff8.jpg[/img]

War Maiden has a curse that will cause your chaos level to rise, as indicated by the scars on your character. Normally, it would be best to use a potion to heal up right away. In War Maiden Mode, you may wish to hold off. After all, if you have to venture back into the same room, you receive the curse again. Or, perhaps the next room you visit will have that curse instead. Still, no sense in holding out forever, so spend wisely.

What do the scars actually do? In Clea 1, Clea’s chaotic face will at times appear. In Clea 2, War Maiden may appear to stalk (but never kill) you. The effect is the same in both cases. When the curse triggers, enemies within the area will be alerted. Not exactly ideal when you are knee deep in War Maiden Mode.

Still, remember the curse timer resets each time you enter a room. This has two implications:

1. You can exit an area, then go back in, to reset the timer.
2. If you have already been in an area for a while, and you dread a curse may be coming, you may prefer to hide in a closet and wait for it to pass first.

[b]Enemy control:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/3b183d78cbfb74a9e89fbc5955815b1e98a6e8c2.jpg[/img]

In War Maiden Mode, it is not enough to only know a foe has entered the adjacent area. Through audio cues, players must develop a telepathic sense of each enemy’s precise location. This guy is on the bottom floor, and that one is in the middle room. Okay, that means I have 10 seconds to go in here, grab this, and run out. This is the skill level we have now reached.

Also remember, there is no need to wait for an enemy to go a certain way. If they disobey, make them head where you want. Run to produce noise and attract your hunters. Use those sound makers (like the bathrooms). Employ balanced aggression.

[b]Map knowledge:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/5700ac53b138b0998f358188ec1076f5bb4ef591.jpg[/img]

Before you think about tackling War Maiden Mode, you may be wise to learn those maps back to front. In Clea 1, know the Whitlock Mansion like your own house. In Clea 2, every realm must become your second home. Each time you travel to another area, there is a chance a new curse will be afflicted. So, think twice before you enter a room. Maybe this area has items you can do without, or nothing at all. Tread with care.

Speaking of map control and movement, no sense in hiding the trick now. Yes, I am talking about the door swap move (the Logsync Swap) where you switch rooms at the same time as your hunter to evade them. For the sake of immersion, I advise against using this trick (unless you are speed running). Even War Maiden Mode has been designed to be beatable without this exploit. That said, War Maiden Mode on Chaos+? If you resort to this trick a time or two, no one will judge.

[b]Final words:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/d857ac84e2f5154b0b1b63486fec47fbe2a7b879.jpg[/img]

To finish up, please let me reiterate. Yes, I have tested War Maiden Mode on Chaos+ to ensure it is beatable. Still, think twice before going in, because it will be hell and beyond. You know about the Master Levels in Doom Eternal? Recently, I had to train for about a month, running the map Taras Nabad over and over, before I was able to beat it on Ultra Nightmare. This is the level of dedication required to keep War Maiden at bay.

Hm? War Maiden Mode on Chaos+ with invisible foes? Okay, let’s not get too crazy.

See you soon, pal. War Maiden Mode is coming ːwhappyː.

notes.title: Post sequel upgrade! (+price changes)
notes.content:
Hi buddy ːcleasunniesː. Hope you are doing well!

Guys, I learned so much during Clea 2's development. When I look back at Clea 1, I go come on now, there is work to do here. So, work I did. Around two years after Clea's release, here is yet another big patch. Your love for Clea inspire me to keep the game healthy and at its best.

[b]New costumes:[/b]

First, this is probably the biggest news of all. Three new costumes have been added to the game, unlocked by default! Two of them were previously costume mods. These are now handpicked to serve as official dresses, available on all platforms (once patches go up):

[u]Halloween:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/999417959c3206746ff10565c72dee8e5ed3301d.jpg[/img]

I have made the lantern smaller compared to how it looked in the costume mod, because I noticed the pumpkin would poke through side walls. The smaller pumpkin is quite cute, actually!

[u]Rain:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/a476885c6f13efefb2bfdb929100b4d5bb140f00.jpg[/img]

Only the best costume mods deserve to become official. Let's face it. When I look back, some mods were simply texture filters, while others had visual glitches that would be hard to repair. This rain dress warrants an official spot by my books. Enjoy!

[u]16-bit:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/fb6c53c214e4e21f1f983a9a3fc7372cb4ded9b5.jpg[/img]

Last up, here is our discord community dress! We held an event where 16 chaos/chaos+ completionists were asked to let their presence be known. Our mighty 16 rocked up, so as promised, the 16-bit dress is now unlocked.

By the way, we have a friendly community that has just passed 100 members, and we hope to schedule more fun events/hangouts in the future. I would love to have you can join us: https://discord.gg/Z2yP6fkqCr

Now for the full list of updates. There is so much here I had to split these into categories. Enjoy, and seriously, please grab this update, then give the game a run. I hope you will like what you see!

[b]Major updates:[/b]

- Lighting fixes across the campaign. Many light sources were far too bright in retrospect, now that I have the experience built from Clea 2's development.
- Fixed an extremely rare bug where, after you peek left/right, your character could be stuck walking in place. For console players, until the patch is up, if you do stumble into this issue, please open and close the inventory, and you will be able to move again.
- The UI used to look slightly wonky on higher resolutions (as you approach 4K). Some buttons would be too big, or the text would be too small, etc. This is no longer the case.

[b]Enemy updates:[/b]

- Enemies' hearing and sight ranges (when in close proximity) will now vary based on difficulty.
- Subtle AI tweaks to grant players more breathing space on lower difficulties.
- The final enemy now seeks the player out more reliably, in exchange for a reduced vision range (as per design).
- Some enemies are no longer invisible on invisible mode, but they are still harder to see (removed light source).
- Fixed a bug where, if you returned from the cells and headed right, you could find an enemy who failed to activate (and be frozen in place).

[b]Gameplay balances:[/b]

- Clea's base speed increased by 0.5. When you return to Clea 1 after Clea 2 (featuring Florine), Clea's movement speed can feel like a slog.
- Difficulty balanced in chapter two.

[b]Visual fixes:[/b]

- Fixed some areas where your lantern can pop slightly through the side walls.
- Fixed minor visual glitch on top of the lantern with the Invisibility Cloak.
- Fixed minor visual glitch on the x-shaped key piece.
- An assortment of other minor fixes. For instance, a cake floating a single pixel above a table in chapter 4.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Removed an exploit where, if you cancel out of the upgrades pop up then immediately pick an option, you can re-use the same crystal ball to obtain all available upgrades.
- Removed a bug where, if you spammed confirm while saving (with infinite saves off), the save could cost you multiple candles. Not replicable on PC versions.

[b]Price changes:[/b]

I also wish to use this chance to be transparent about price changes for Clea 1 and 2. Once approved by Valve, both games will be 13.99 USD on Steam. Here are the key reasons behind the change:

- Clea 1 was originally priced at only around 8 dollars. Both publishers I have spoken to, and even several players, mentioned this was far too low. I am thankful players would say that, and I learned a lot in terms of what price range is acceptable. To be honest, I highly doubt any game I release from now on will be priced that low, or I will not be able to sustain myself on these titles (unless I create mini-games).

- After Clea 1's launch, chaos+, arcade mode, invisible mode, along with additional unlockable costumes, had been added. I hope these additions have increased the game's replay value, and therefore also worthy of the new price.

- Clea 2, meanwhile, will have its cost reduced by a dollar to match Clea 1's. I want to do this, because now that Clea 1 has received the aforementioned updates, it has a similar amount of content as its sequel. It is only right for them to be priced the same in this case. Please note, this will happen in around 30 days.

- The console versions are slightly higher in price, because they have bonus dresses to make up for the fact PC supports costumes mods.

As usual, thank you for hearing me out. Any thoughts, I am here to listen and discuss. Everyone in the community has always been reasonable, which makes me comfortable with sharing my exact thoughts. To sum up, I feel like I have made a mistake with the pricing, so thank you for letting me make these corrections.

I have the next four days off because it is Easter break here. Please, give the patched version a run, and let me know if you spot any issues. I am keen to resolve things right away. This is the best version of Clea yet, and I wish to keep her sparkling clean.

Over the next few days, I will run regression tests on the console versions. Once they pass my tests, I will push patches out, and soon enough, Clea will be at her best on all platforms. Happy days.

Thank you ːcleahappyː!

notes.title: Clea November update (1 Ups feature and more)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/25c6ca773ccd5a5615b39727ddb669a5aa146e30.jpg[/img]

Hello there ːcleasunniesː! Hope you have been doing well. A patch just went up for the Steam edition of Clea. Please note the same updates will be up first on Itch.io (should be in a matter of days), followed by consoles (could be in several weeks due to the approval processes involved).

First, here are the smaller items:

a) In chapter 2, there was a cake that was placed quite close to a painting, so players could select the unwanted item. I have moved the cake away more.

b) In a secret chapter, there was a dialogue box that underlapped a side wall. This has been fixed.

c) On the Switch version, if you bind B to another command, the cancel command will become unbound. This will be fixed when the patch goes up for consoles.

Now, for some of the bigger things:

1) When players die, they can now skip the monster roar sound effect by pressing any button. Clea is a challenging game. No shame in growing through setbacks. Now the process will be that much smoother.

2) When you start a new game for the first time, a pop up will now appear and ask if you wish to activate infinite saves. I had designed Clea with limited saves in mind. In Resident Evil 1, for example, I had to run a route multiple times until I perfected it, then I would execute that run, and when I used that ink ribbon at the end, boy did it feel gratifying.

But I will admit, once the modern options came, I took advantage. In Resident Evil 3, I nearly saved after every zombie kill! However players wish to play, I take pride in supporting it. The pop up does ask players to please consider playing without infinite saves, perhaps on a subsequent run, but it is ultimately your freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/456f2b6c2088e2fbb43e6af7f12740277a68c2ee.jpg[/img]

3) Last, and the biggest one, is the new 1 Ups feature. This can be activated via the difficulty selection screen. Before we get too excited, this is a feature for those who find the game difficult. If you have already dominated the campaign, there is nothing to see here. Chaos+ (with invisibility set on even) is where the monster tier players belong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/c7622fb8dd90289d079b0a789965daf8935f0f3c.jpg[/img]

With 1 Ups on, players will find green orbs scattered throughout the campaign. Each one will save players from death a single time. It has recently come to my attention that Clea is quite a challenging title. In fact, I have updated the Steam page's description to emphasize this. While Clea is a horror game, I would like it to primarily be a test of players' skills. To struggle, to grow from setbacks (learning patterns etc), then eventually dominating even the toughest modes. That to me is sheer joy.

By the way, 1 Ups mode will not activate in Chaos, Chaos+ and Arcade Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/0c0d83ea2be4740e1d59a420aaea5bed1743d8bb.jpg[/img]

I may as well speak of this briefly here. You know about the Ancient Gods 1 DLC that recently came out for Doom Eternal? In the original game, many players/reviewers protested about the design of this monster named the Marauder. He was challenging to many, to a point where it ruined the experience for them. Some even wanted this demon removed altogether.

Instead, in the DLC, the designers made us fight two at a time, and some other tricks I will not spoil. I want to ask you to imagine yourself as a game creator for a moment (perhaps you are). Consider the courage it takes to take this kind of stance. I had beaten Doom Eternal on Ultra Nightmare (max difficulty on one life), yet this DLC has been pushing me to develop new knowledge, to enhance my skills further. There is no greater joy than mastering a game you love.

That said, again, I see it as a challenge to design a game just about anyone can enjoy. From the newest of the new to those gamer gods. Doom Eternal, of course, also has lower difficulty settings.

As usual, if you spot any errors in this new patch, please notify me right away! I am going to jump onto that first thing.

These updates have not been fully tested for Clea 2's demo yet. Once I manage that, I will push the same patch up.

Thank you so much ːcleahappyː!

notes.title: September patch, plus price change
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/196974cf3ca96565e759d7db9be4aac408ac718a.jpg[/img]

Hey gang ːcleahappyː! Hope you have all been doing well. You may have noticed a few Clea updates being pushed over the months. They are small fixes/improvements, but when I am a fan of a game, I want to know every drop of detail. So, I would like to provide the same for you. Here are the recent changes:

- Fixed a bug where, if you attempted to bind a command to the right analogue stick on a controller, the game broke and forced you to restart.
- Fixed a bug where, if you paused the game right as an enemy was about to move, they would glide across the screen with no animation played.

Now for the second topic. I would like to raise Clea's price by 3 USD ːahhː. Once Valve approves my request, the change will be applied. Here are my thoughts behind this:

1) Since Clea's release, the biggest additions were:

- Chaos+ and invisible modes
- Camera feature
- Arcade mode
- New unlockable costumes that come with these new modes

With these new features, I like to think the game has levelled up, so to speak. Clea deserves better ːvintywhyː.

2) As you know, our console releases are on the way. In some cases, there are now more parties involved. Publisher, other platform partners etc. I need to ensure this is financially viable for everyone. At the previous price point, it was not.

Please note, since the console variants have unique costumes (while the PC edition has seasonal ones), the Steam version will still be at a lower price point (by a few dollars). Still, I want to avoid a huge cost difference between platforms.

Since it is only a few dollars, I imagine this is one of those cases where I am over-worrying. Still, with these things, I always want to be the one to speak on it first ːcleanormː.

These are things I struggle with and learn from as my situation/career has been improving. I hope overall, players will be happy for the team and me. Thank you for your support ːcleasunniesː!

notes.title: Clea July update (anniversary artbook, console ports)
notes.content:

Hey pals ːcleasunniesː! Hope you have all been safe. Sure wish this awful year will improve as we enter the second half. When I stress over it too much, I find myself going a bit mental. Let's all look after one another.

We have tried our hardest to keep working through these tough times. There has been delays sadly. Nonetheless, we are near that finish line in several areas, so I would like to provide an update.

First, Clea's Anniversary Artbook is scheduled for release next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314900/Clea__Anniversary_Artbook

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/e71b3e95009a16e80fa3b32745fa22e8269f942d.jpg[/img]

Now, how about those Switch and Xbox ports? Please keep in touch via the newsletter ([url=https://invertmouse.com]https://invertmouse.com[/url]), social media etc, because we are extremely close to being able to announce solid dates. notes.title: Clea June update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/7df1dc384fe2493aea4062955a2294db7f60db47.png[/img]

Hi everyone ːcleahappyː! Hope you are all having an awesome weekend. I have pushed a patch just now with a decent list of changes:

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Decreased reaction time for an enemy in chapter 4. This will only be noticeable on Light difficulty.
- Enemy "alert" sounds are now softer when he/she is farther away.
- Added more echo to enemy footsteps when they are in a different room. Now, even without the heartbeats, players can tell how much danger they are in.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Minor sound effect adjustments (some being too loud).
- Animation fixes (some limbs broke when you changed directions rapidly).

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
- Added more cakes across the campaign. That said, the intended experience is for infinite saves to be off, and with no candles, cakes mean nothing ːcleasmugː.
- Increased pan speed when you stop panning left/right.

[b]UI:[/b]
- Added default button to gamma screen.

As usual, if you catch any issues, please let me know! It is, after all, why I choose to push patches on weekends. In the meantime, I am off to more Doom Eternal Ultra Nightmare training (up to Super Gore Nest), and I might try out some of that new Streets of Rage, too.

Many thanks ːcleasunniesː!

notes.title: Clea June update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/3d9dfc1183ba6e255fa2edc1acecdfd805aadcd6.jpg[/img]


Hi friends ːcleahappyː. Yo, please stay safe, first of all. That is more important than anything else right now.

I have just pushed a June patch up for Clea. Technical changes only this time. Here they are:

- Contrast slider was reversed, so the lower the value, the brighter the screen. This has been resolved. Because of this, if you are an existing player, next time you open the game, you will be prompted to adjust brightness/contrast again. Thanks for your understanding!

- You can now adjust brightness/contrast via the menu even while you are in-game.

- Brightness/contrast slider now shifts more slowly with keyboard buttons so you have more control. This feature was added for console ports.

- If you care to know, the logo splash video's volume will now also change based on your chosen master volume. This is needed because on some TVs, the logo videos' volume is way too loud.

Please make full use of these features! Now you can make the game darker for a spookier atmosphere, or brighten things a bit if you think/wish that will help you dominate the campaign. As for me, I tend to prefer sharper color contrasts, so I will make sure to tweak that to my liking.

As usual, I picked Friday / the weekend to upload this patch. If anything is wrong, please let me know, and I can get onto it right away.

Thank you and take care ːcleasunniesː!

notes.title: Clea May update (please check!)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/c0c993b50ef2fbebd5e7022f55fb92a87a0df801.jpg[/img]

Hi buds ːcleahappyː! Hope you are all happy and safe. Been working everyday on Clea’s ports, along with that upcoming new project. I have pushed an update for Clea on Steam just now. Here is the biggest change:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/96c5805db9e24f413d40f172f4a417b4207ed5c5.jpg[/img]

You know those brightness/contrast adjustment screens that appear at the start of console games? Well, because Clea is on her way to consoles, I have added that feature. To maintain codebases more easily, I have pushed this same feature to the Steam build as well.

See, when I tested one of Clea’s ports, the game looked far too bright on my TV. Bad gamma can destroy a game, so this change is a must. I check the screenshots section of Clea regularly on Steam. All this time, I have seen one or two screenshots where the brightness was too high. This adjustment screen should resolve that issue for those players.

Of course, every update comes with its risks (old or new bugs). Because of this, I would love to ask for a favor. Could you download this update (should be automatic), then see how things look?

After the update, as soon as you open the game, it should detect you have not gone through the display adjustment and show that screen to you. Please tweak the bars as you see fit (probably not even needed in most cases), then check how the game looks/performs. If you spot any bugs, please let me know right away. I will revert the update, then make the necessary fixes.

A few other small tweaks:

- Some of the double doors in chapter 4 opened at odd angles. They have been fixed.
- Updated some enemy footsteps that sounded too metallic.
- Adjusted the volume of enemy footsteps, some of which were too loud/obnoxious.

Again, to help maintain different versions of Clea (Steam, Switch, Xbox etc), I had to upgrade my engine, re-export fonts etc. Outside of the Chaos+, Invisible and Arcade Mode updates, this is probably the riskiest patch yet. So, for real, please let me know if you find any issues. I will be here all weekend.

Take care ːcleasunniesː!

notes.title: Challenge ideas
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/9cae06e20751a7cb2bcd69c306a31eb7b49b5c65.jpg[/img]

[i]Thank you BADA for the artwork![/i]

Hey friends! Hope you are all doing good :bibi:.

I am delighted to see some players have already said they accept the upcoming challenge modes. You know, many games do not support such extra features, yet fans are still able to create their own fun. Beat Final Fantasy I with 4 of the same class, Doom 4 on Ultra Nightmare with only the pistol (yikes). This is what makes our community so awesome.

To participate in that spirit, and also to help players prep for Chaos+, I want to share some challenge ideas of mine:

[u]Easy:[/u]
- No potions used.
- No running.
- No left/right peek.

[u]Medium:[/u]
- Game over if you are seen.
- No door peek.
- No closets used.

[u]Hard:[/u]
- Game over if you are heard (aside from puzzles).
- Zero saves.
- Never enter a room more than once (within reason).
- S-rank Chaos Mode with the best ending.

Feel free to combine these as you see fit (some may be impossible together). Above all else, of course, have fun! Since the medals update is also on the way, perhaps you may wish to obtain them while conquering my trials? Hopefully these challenges will prepare you for Chaos+, too.

Then again, probably not :sasalewd:.

notes.title: Introducing badges
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/394400266d234c4d2fb4b862ce38ad51f1e5d4f9.jpg[/img]

“Hey, I don’t recognize those icons!”

Good morning friends :bibi:. Indeed, as you can see, I have added yet another feature to the upcoming challenge modes update. These are badges players can unlock by completing the campaign. What do the badges do? Honestly, they exist purely for bragging rights :a2:.

There are 4 badges available for each difficulty. 3 badges to represent the 3 endings, then the 4th one will showcase your highest rank under that mode. For example, in the above screenshot, I have achieved S-rank on Dark Mode.

Of course, once the challenge modes update rolls in, the most boast-worthy icons will be the 4 linked to Chaos+. Please be warned, though. Best ending on Chaos+? That would mean you must backtrack between levels while surrounded by extremely aggressive foes, and you barely have any candles. In other words, Clea Masters only.

Oh, and also, if you unlock any of these badges under Invisible Mode, you will be rewarded accordingly:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/5c4a22fe0eb67ec133b109286a3603eaa82e8208.jpg[/img]

If you obtain all four Chaos+ icons along with those eyeballs? You are a monster. I have no words :whappy:.

A few notes:

- As several players have asked, yes, you can unlock the Invisible Cloak, then use that to cheese through Chaos+. This means, once you have the Invisible Cloak, you can unlock all the badges with ease. Please note, however, that even if you impress your friends, your heart shall never be at peace :ahh:!

- Since these medals require new flags to trigger upon campaign completion, even if you have beaten Clea multiple times before, once the update kicks in, the game unfortunately will not know. Sorry about that :vintywhy:! This is the drawback of having new ideas post-release. If enough players desire it, I could create a secret menu where you can unlock these medals with the click of a mouse, and it will be on you to be honest when it comes to which icons you have earned.

- Your highest rank for each difficulty will be chosen. This means, if you clear Chaos Mode with an S-rank, then switch on Invisible Mode but only achieve a B-rank, the eyeball icon will not appear.

“Mouse, you’re so creative! If only I had your creative—”

I stole the idea from Doom’s Arcade Mode :sasalewd:.

notes.title: Introducing Chaos Mode
notes.content:
Morning friends :bibi:! I would like to introduce something to you today—Chaos mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/e51fa663ce6f421b06732033d56c4688161f9d15.jpg[/img]

Players must complete the campaign once before this mode is unlocked. How hard is it? Well, let’s get more specific.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/86809a7f9710ab2f02083b39362d5d222256faee.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/f3faeb6d03d68f6efb155de50351d9a12485dcfe.jpg[/img]

On Chaos mode, the Chaos Servants are fast. In addition, they barely ever pause to rest, plus their hearing is extremely sensitive. Make one noise, and these guys will beeline for you. Stand still for too long? Game over. Keep moving and you might just stand a ghost of a chance.

By the way, on Chaos (and hard mode), each save will cost you a mana candle. No candle, no save. Better spend those resources wisely.

Now, what do you get for tormenting yourself through this nightmare? While this is all subject to change, there are 3 potential rewards:

1. An achievement (of course)
2. A bonus costume to show the world you have conquered the darkest of all evils
3. A certificate (in the gallery section) with your completion date, and also a unique number (e.g. 3 if you are the third ever person to defeat Chaos mode)

As always, I hope you can consider wishlisting Clea on Steam:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/981020/Clea/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/981020/Clea/[/url]

Will you have what it takes to beat Chaos mode? Hope to see you on the other side :yoyo:!

Hi everyone. A week has passed since Clea's prototype release, and I have received a lot of helpful feedback! New versions of the game have been uploaded here:

[url=http://clea.invertmouse.com]http://clea.invertmouse.com[/url]

Here are the bugs I have fixed:
[list]
[*] It is possible for the Chaos Servant to get stuck on the first floor, and if you use an arcane candle on him.
[*] Text overflow issues on lower resolutions.
[*] Keys cannot be used to open doors if another item is in the way.
[*] No shadow on the Chaos Servant.
[*] Game over screen can be skipped by spamming confirm.
[/list]
Those were the most urgent items. Beyond that, in response to early feedback, I hope to:
[list]
[*] Add fire escape areas so players can tell they are traversing between different floors.
[*] Perform animation tweaks.
[*] Adjust combinable item colors to avoid confusion.
[*] Give the player time to explore the controls before spawning a Chaos Servant.
[*] Add tips upon death to help players improve their next run.
[*] Offer different key types, or complete rebinds.
[/list]
Please note these are only the feedback specific improvements. I have even more features planned ahead, so I hope you can look forward to upcoming posts.

To those who are not aware of the special thanks campaign, please remember it ends on December 31st. Let's make sure to read up on the rules:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/981020/announcements/detail/1708449632692798961]https://steamcommunity.com/games/981020/announcements/detail/1708449632692798961[/url]
Thank you!

notes.title: Prototype incoming (with special thanks offer)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33966737/47c016db825f8620fa5b3aa99c1d36c69cc82c90.png[/img]

Hi everyone. So glad to have you in the community for this first post :vintysmile:. The prototype of Clea is almost ready! Please check out this page for some early info:

[url=http://clea.invertmouse.com]http://clea.invertmouse.com[/url]

The prototype will be released on December 1st, 2018. Until December 31st, 2018, if you submit feedback, you can have your name listed in the credits under special thanks. To become eligible, please read through the following:

1. Once you have played through the prototype, please submit your feedback to contact(at)invertmouse(dot)com.

2. Please submit a reasonable amount of feedback, rather than just "good game thanks for the shoutout". Suggestions, bug reports—all thoughts are welcome.

3. Include your preferred name (or alias) in the email subject. For instance, "Clea feedback (InvertMouse)". For your privacy, those who do not include a preferred name will not be listed.

Several other points to be aware of:

i. Trolls will be ignored, of course.

ii. Unfortunately, there is always a chance your email may end up in spam, or simply be lost for one reason or another. I will keep a closer eye on my junk folder during this period, but I apologize to those who miss out due to this reason.

iii. If there is a large number of submissions (let's say thousands upon thousands), I may also opt to cut off the special thanks period early. Otherwise, I will have no time to develop this game, which is a detriment to us all.

I hope we can focus on Clea as the priority, while this special thanks offer serves as a bonus. With this mindset, hopefully there is no disappointment to be had.

Last, please note it will be impossible to act on everyone's response. Still, your comment may trigger subtle ideas in a future title, so every word is precious.

Thank you! Hope to hear from you real soon.

P.S. Thank you to those who have already wishlisted this game and joined the community group! Please look forward to more news as I develop beyond this prototype :yoyo:.
